messages:
matt: Draft RFC is up: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/prefetch-qos-edgecases — PTAL @sophie @raj

sophie: skimmed. looks solid but we need explicit launch acceptance criteria. please add p50/p95 targets + an error budget for automatic fallback :eyes:

raj: fwiw, FinCorp flagged this as blocker for Dedicated. they want deterministic p95 ≤150ms for 2k tokens under steady concurrency. they'll push for a commitment if we can meet it

anya: okay, product priority is clear — enterprise request beats micro-optimizations. propose we narrow scope: implement kernel-selector + KV-prefetch policy + rollout gates. defer attn-kernel rewrites to follow-up

matt: agreed. I updated the Scope section to reflect kernel-selector + kv-prefetch only. added rollout plan: canary 1% -> 10% -> 50% with automatic fallback to baseline kernel on regressions

sophie: acceptance test suggestions: 1) perf harness: synthetic replay up to seq=2048, 2) regression eval against customer prompt-set, 3) chaos test: kill 1 node + validate p95 remains within budget

raj: ops asks we include cost-per-token delta for each kernel variant (float32 vs quantized vs prefetch-enabled). need that to model Dedicated pricing impacts

matt: added a cost-estimate table in the doc. sample config we plan to use below:

```yaml
kernel_policy:
  primary: 'kv-prefetch-v2'
  fallback: 'baseline'
  routing:
    latency_slo_ms: 150
    qos: high
    eviction_policy: 'lru-approx'
```

sophie: also we must define the KV eviction edge-case: streaming long chat + many cold prefixes -> cache thrash. proposed acceptance: miss-rate for top-5 prefixes ≤ 10% under steady traffic

raj: add rollout kill-switch: automatic route to baseline if p95 > 200ms sustained for >2 minutes (configurable threshold)

ci-bot: build 4421 failed on unit tests: runtime/kernel_selector_test.py::test_policy_priority — see CI logs https://ci.redwood/build/4421

matt: on it, fixing tests and updating selector mocks :wrench:

deploy-bot: staging deploy queued for canary at 2026-04-02T18:00Z (manual approval required)

anya: next steps summary: 1) eng-runtime to update RFC with acceptance checklist + cost table, 2) ops to validate chaos and perf harness, 3) PM to confirm FinCorp acceptance criteria. target: freeze scope by tomorrow EOD and aim for Q2 ship

sophie: I'll add the checklist items directly to the doc and add the regression prompt-set. will review changes tomorrow morning :calendar: 

raj: I'll upload FinCorp SRE traces and their p95 histograms to the RFC thread for calibration

matt: thanks everyone. if no major objections we'll freeze scope tomorrow EOD and start the PRD handoff to PMs. :shipit:
